query: Help me understand the key points in this table — what should I concentrate on?

per_column.name: cabin_crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Quality of cabin crew interaction is a core aspect OF service quality.

per_column.name: operational_reliability
per_column.rationale: On-time performance, delays, cancellations, and luggage handling are constitutive aspects of the airline's service delivery quality.

per_column.name: food_beverage_quality
per_column.rationale: The quality of onboard food and beverage is a distinct aspect OF the overall service experience.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_configuration
per_column.rationale: Physical comfort of the seat is a constitutive dimension of inflight service quality.

per_column.name: customer_service_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Responsiveness of customer service is an aspect of service quality, though it overlaps heavily with cabin_crew_service_quality (both capture staff helpfulness/attitude).

per_column.name: compensation_claim_resolution
per_column.rationale: How the airline handles refunds/compensation is a legitimate service-recovery aspect OF service quality.

per_column.name: route_complexity_itinerary
per_column.rationale: Number of connections/legs is a property of the itinerary itself, not an aspect of the airline's service quality; it may predict satisfaction but is not constitutive of the concept.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine constitutive facets of airline service quality (crew, reliability, food, seat comfort, service recovery), so meronymy largely holds. However, mutual exclusivity is weakened because cabin_crew_service_quality and customer_service_responsiveness substantially overlap — both capture staff helpfulness and attitude under different names. route_complexity_itinerary is not a facet at all but a property of the itinerary (external predictor), diluting the set. Exhaustiveness is fairly good: the facets cover crew, comfort, catering, punctuality/reliability, and service recovery, though value-for-money/pricing and inflight entertainment (present in the original table) are notable uncovered constitutive aspects.
